method.registry_probe: Single bounded GET https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=<token>&limit=100 per token, 20s timeout, first page only, sequential, no background loops, curl -s -m 20 inline inside one bounded shell loop per Bash call (2 calls to cover all 100 tokens after the first hit the 2-minute tool timeout mid-loop and resumed from where it left off). count = servers.length on page 1. our_rank = [1-based index, name] for every row on that page whose name matches /theluckystrike/i.
method.token_set: The 97-token union used by docs/NAMING_R4_RESULT.md (66 tokens from data/organic.json servers[].query_set as tracked at the time + the 38 new tokens named in that round's brief, de-duplicated) plus zip, archive, compress, qr-code (compress already in the 97) -- 100 distinct tokens probed live on 2026-09-04.
method.findable_share_formula: NAMING_R4 formula, unchanged: p = min(1, 10/our_rank) if our current-version row appears on page 1 for that token, else 0; mean over the full 100-token set.
method.release_check: node scripts/release-check.mjs, read-only, no network, no writes.
method.compare_none_mechanism: release-check.mjs's compare check now accepts data/facts.json compare_none.<server> = {date, tokens} in place of a billing/src/compare.js COMPARE[server] entry, valid for 30 days from date; past that it fails again with an explicit expired message so the registry gets re-probed for a competitor rather than the gap staying silently excused.

failures: 2 of the first 100 curl responses (meeting, time tracker) failed json.load on first parse (a non-ASCII escape and an empty 0-byte body respectively) and were re-fetched individually before the findable-share computation; both included in the final 100-token/74-matched count.
